depublish_bridge.name: Depublish bridge
depublish_bridge.description: Permanently retract every entity currently shown for a peer bridge you've confirmed is dead (decommissioned, migrated, etc.) -- clears its retained MQTT messages so it stops reappearing on every restart. Only use this for a bridge you know is no longer publishing; it has no way to tell an inactive bridge from a merely quiet one.
